scenes.matchFrom: The Chapter sent her a whore folded up
scenes.alt: A rented room above a rope-walk. Rain runs down the shutter. A candle burns beside an untouched cup of wine.

token.alt: A brass token worn smooth on one face, stamped on the other with an empty cup on its side.

scenes.matchFrom: Seraine put her hood up and went out into the weather
scenes.alt: Cairnmouth in autumn. Rain sideways into everyone's business. A hooded figure walks into it.

interactions.matchAt: Instead she sat with the brass warming in her fist

pageArt.matchFrom: Outside, Cairnmouth was doing what Cairnmouth did in autumn
pageArt.matchAfter: She poured more wine and did not drink it
pageArt.alt: Cairnmouth under hard autumn rain, seen from Seraine's upstairs window. Rope-makers walk backward along wet lengths of hemp below.
pageArt.caption: Cairnmouth, in autumn.
